data.Q: Who prays to the Lord for the king?
Which person has a healed hand after the man of God prays?
For what does the king ask the man of God to pray?
data.A: for the king’s hand to be restored
data.wrong_answer: for a meal and a gift

data.Q: What does the king say to the man of God after the king’s hand is healed?
data.A: The king invites the man of God home for food and offers a gift
data.wrong_answer: The king asks the man of God to pray for healing
